Hungarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From German Profil, from Italian profilo.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈprofil]
  • Hyphenation: pro‧fil
  • Rhymes: -il

Noun

[edit]

profil (plural profilok)

  1. profile (a side view of a person's head or of an object)
  2. (architecture) profile (a section of any member, made at right angles with its main lines)
  3. (formal) profile (the field of activity of a company, plant, or institution)

Indonesian

[edit]
Indonesian Wikipedia has an article on:
profil
Wikipedia id

Etymology

[edit]

From Dutch profiel, from French profil, from Italian profilo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈprofɪl]
  • Hyphenation: pro‧fil

Noun

[edit]

profil (plural profil-profil)

  1. profile:
    1. the outermost shape, view, or edge of an object
      Synonym: penampang
    2. the shape, view, or shadow of a person's head from the side; a side view
    3. summary or collection of information, especially about a person

Affixed terms

[edit]
  • pemrofil
  • pemrofilan

Polish

[edit]
Polish Wikipedia has an article on:
profil
Wikipedia pl

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French profil, from Italian profilo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈprɔ.fil/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔfil
  • Syllabification: pro‧fil

Noun

[edit]

profil m inan

  1. profile (shape, view, or shadow of a person's head from the side)
  2. profile (outermost shape)
  3. profile (totality of related characteristics)
    Synonyms: charakter, kierunek, zakres
  4. (social media) profile (space with personal information in software or Internet systems)
  5. (geology) profile (vertical cross-section showing the geological structure of a given section of the earth's crust)
  6. (architecture) profile (decorative strip projecting above the surface of a wall, furniture, etc.)
  7. (geometry) profile (outline of the cross-section of an object)
  8. (engineering) profile (hot rolled structural steel shape like an I-beam)
    Synonym: kształtownik
  9. (criminology, psychology) offender profile

Declension

[edit]
Declension of profil
singular plural
nominative profil profile
genitive profilu profili/profilów
dative profilowi profilom
accusative profil profile
instrumental profilem profilami
locative profilu profilach
vocative profilu profile

Derived terms

[edit]
adjective
  • profilowy
adverb
  • z profilu
noun
  • profilowanie
verbs
  • profilować impf
  • sprofilować pf
  • wyprofilować pf

Noun

profil (definite accusative profili, plural profiller)
